subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 13 updates

question: Should OpenClaw accept these exact 13 third-party action revisions in the credentialed security, publishing, token, and Codex-agent workflows?
rationale: The patch is mechanically consistent, but accepting new executable supply-chain revisions with access to secrets or write permissions is an owner trust decision that automated review cannot make safely.

options.title: Approve Final Exact Head
options.body: Have secops and the release-workflow owner approve the immutable revisions after required checks complete on the final head.

options.title: Split Privileged Updates
options.body: Separate the Codex, token, CodeQL, and container-publishing action families if owners want isolated rollout and rollback evidence.

recommendation.title: Approve Final Exact Head
recommendation.body: Have secops and the release-workflow owner approve the immutable revisions after required checks complete on the final head.
